thread:
elaine: handing off - small regional degradation in EU-WEST affecting embedding requests (p95 latency ~4.2s, baseline ~120ms). triggered at ~08:12 UTC, now 08:18 UTC. impact: ~2% of hosted traffic (embeddings route), a couple customers reported slow responses.

elaine: what's been done so far:
- scaled up embed pool by +2 nodes (autoscaler lagged)
- pinned routing to eu-west-standby to avoid spill to overloaded hosts
- cleared a stuck worker group with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-pool-eu`
- temporary rate-limit increase applied for internal health checks to avoid noisy retries

ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-8342 (severity S2) - embedding p95 elevated in eu-west. Pager sent to oncall. link: https://incidents.internal/r/INC-2026-8342

jordan: @elaine thanks. I'm coming up to speed. any customer-facing pages?

elaine: no public status page update yet. PSAT owners: @sasha (platform-sales) and @matt-cs notified. I filed a quick note in the customer-impact doc: https://confluence.internal/ops/INC-2026-8342-impact

sam: looked at host metrics - one machine showing high GC churn and steady retries to the model server. suspect OOM churn causing request queueing. logs: ```
2026-03-14T08:10:12Z embed-srv[pid:4123] WARN memory pressure: LRU evictions rising
2026-03-14T08:11:01Z kernel: OOM-killer invoked for process model-infer
```

sam: I drained the node (cordon + drain) and removed it from LB. that dropped 0.6% traffic and latency improved slightly. still seeing tail spikes.

leo: FYI I pushed a conservative engine config rollback (reverted perf tweak from last night) on eu-west canaries: `service/engine -> image: engine:v2.4.1` -> `engine:v2.4.0`. deploy-bot reports success for canary, rolling to remainder in 2m.

deploy-bot: ROLLING DEPLOY: engine:v2.4.0 -> eu-west (canary ok). window: 08:16-08:25 UTC.

elaine: current status: degraded -> partial recovery in progress. customer impact small but visible. primary: jordan (taking next shift), secondary: sam. handover notes below.

elaine: ACTIONS for next shift:
- jordan: validate the rollback finish and confirm p95 below 300ms for embeddings over next 30m
- sam: follow up on the drained node; check kubelet logs and kernel OOMs, open a host ticket if disk/memory pressure persists
- leo: if tail latency doesn't drop after rollback completes, revert to engine:v2.4.2-rc and /or enable debug tracing for a limited window (coordinate with privacy)
- oncall: keep incident tagged S2; escalate to S1 if >5% customers affected or any customer page escalates

jordan: ack. I'll run quick synthetic across eu-west and eu-central and post results here. also will check redis KV cache hit rates per-tenant (maybe cache thrash).

sam: also leaving a note to run `sudo dmesg -T | grep -i oom` on the drained host and attach to host ticket. if we see repeated OOMs, we should blacklist the host from future scheduling until repro is root-caused.

leo: quick metric snippet to watch: `embed.p95, engine.rpc_retries, node.memory.free, kube.evictions`. alert thresholds I adjusted: embed.p95 -> warn 350ms / trigger S2 1000ms.

jordan: synthetic: eu-west embed p95 dropped to 310ms after canary rollback but occasional spikes to ~800ms still visible (every ~7min). I'll keep an eye and will ping if trend worsens. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks team. for the handoff I put runbook links inline: 
- runbook: https://playbooks.internal/embed-tail-latency
- host troubleshooting: https://ops.internal/host-troubleshoot
- customer impact template: https://templates.internal/cs-incident-note

elaine: handing off now to @jordan (primary) and @sam (secondary). I'll be available Slack-first for 15m in case of questions. leaving the bridge open for now (bridge: #incident-8342-bridge).
